scope: Read-only source, current metadata, official fixed-commit network identity and CPU regression review; no benchmark scores recalculated, no GPU, no runtime or README edits

methods.identity: CHOMP adaptation, local implementation; not official MoveIt CHOMP
methods.formula: J(Q)=w_s/2 ||D2 Q||_F^2 + w_o sum_i .5[c(d_i)+c(d_i+1)] ||q_i+1-q_i||_2; interior update=-eta A^-1 grad J, A=D2_interior^T D2_interior, scaled by a fixed positive scalar and bounded/backtracked
methods.objective: Squared joint acceleration plus canonical-clearance C-space arc integral; evaluation is actual PWL joint length
methods.collision: Canonical primitive minimum signed clearance, piecewise-linear/quadratic CHOMP potential; analytic active feature gradient with finite differences at ties; final common validator required
methods.stopping: 40 iterations, 8 backtracks, 1e-7 relative-cost threshold or line-search stationary, within outer deadline
methods.conclusion: Real covariant functional descent with obstacle terms, not a renamed generic smoother. Explicit C-space-vs-workspace functional adaptation remains accurate.
limitations: Uses a C-space minimum-clearance functional instead of integrating workspace body-point collision potentials.
Penalty optimization may return colliding paths; this is caught rather than relabelled success.

methods.identity: Unchanged official ros-industrial STOMP core plus canonical geometry task callbacks
methods.formula: Noise covariance proportional to inverse acceleration metric; native p_r,t proportional to exp[-h(S_r,t-min_r S_r,t)/(max_r S_r,t-min_r S_r,t)], normalized across rollouts; native weighted noise updates then STOMP smoothing matrix and bounded endpoint-preserving projection
methods.objective: Official normalized acceleration control cost plus canonical signed-clearance waypoint potential; PWL length evaluated separately
methods.collision: Same full model via Model.clearance; final candidate polyline check and common final validator
methods.stopping: 40 native iterations, 12 rollouts, native iterations-after-valid setting5; local callbacks enforce remaining outer deadline
methods.conclusion: Authentic official probability-weighted rollout optimization, not generic added-noise search. Four checked official files are byte-identical.
limitations: Local canonical-geometry task, correlated-noise generator, projection and update limiter are declared adapters.
Native STOMP return does not certify continuous collision freedom.

methods.identity: Unchanged author BasicTrustRegionSQP/BPMPD optimizer with local canonical collision transcription
methods.formula: min sum_i ||q_i+1-q_i||_2^2; g=clearance-distance<=0, linearized at current iterate; trust-region sequential convex QP with L1 merit and escalating constraint penalties
methods.objective: Squared joint differences, not pure PWL length; reported comparison metric is PWL length
methods.collision: Canonical signed clearance at three segment collocation subdivisions; analytic/central-difference derivative chained through interpolation matrix; fixed endpoints/joint bounds
methods.stopping: 50 SQP iterations, max5 merit increases, 45s optimizer cap bounded by total query deadline; final validator retained
methods.conclusion: Author trust-region SQP and BPMPD are truly called. Three key author optimizer source files are byte-identical. POSIX transport fixes are recorded separately from optimizer code.
limitations: Uses finite segment collocation, not author OpenRAVE swept-volume collision transcription.
Must remain named adaptation; misses between sample points are failures under final validator.

methods.identity: Official OMPL2.0.1 native RRTConnect with canonical state/motion callbacks
methods.formula: Bidirectional RRT expansion and connect; exact endpoint solution; native reduceVertices postprocess
methods.objective: Feasible path first, then length-nonincreasing vertex reduction; not shortest-path optimality
methods.collision: 0.01rad Euclidean motion subdivisions include both endpoints; canonical CSD checker; common0.005rad validation after solve
methods.stopping: First exact solution or remaining planning deadline; current explicit config caps search at60s but subtracts validation5s and simplification0.5s from overall deadline
methods.conclusion: Official native tree implementation. Exact-goal gate and common final validator remain active.
limitations: Main run has no intermediate callback; missing first-valid times are correctly left unavailable.
Historical10s search results must remain separate from current60s configuration.

methods.identity: Official OMPL2.0.1 native RRTstar with rewiring and path-length objective
methods.formula: PathLengthOptimizationObjective; native near-neighbor parent selection/rewiring, goal_bias.05, range.5rad, rewire_factor1.1, delayed collision checking
methods.objective: Continually improve actual native joint PWL length until termination condition
methods.collision: Same canonical callbacks and final independent validation as RRTConnect
methods.stopping: Current config planning_seconds60; one uninterrupted native solve until min(adapter_start+60,query_deadline-5-.5). Main observer disabled so no observation overhead or repeated restart.
methods.conclusion: Actual CPU native test ran12.479s using current60s configured cap and18s outer fixture deadline, exceeding former10s cap while preserving5s validator reserve. Impossible barrier stayed failure.
limitations: 60s denotes full query budget; it cannot mean60s search plus validation.
Finite state/motion checks and finite budget do not establish completeness or global optimality.

methods.identity: Native CSDecomp EI-ZO plus unchanged author scsplanning.polygonal.get_points
methods.formula: EI-ZO: delta_k=6delta/(pi^2 k^2), M=ceil[2log(1/delta_k)/(epsilon tau^2)], hit-and-run, collision bisection and separating cuts; LSCS minimizes sum ||p_i+1-p_i|| subject to both segment endpoints in ordered convex region
methods.objective: Shortest PWL length in the supplied ordered corridor
methods.collision: Fixed canonical model; original CUDA inflate/edit regions; numerical coverage repairs and collision feedback retained; final common validator
methods.stopping: EI-ZO30 iterations with epsilon=delta=.005,Np10000,Nf10,mixing60;20 recovery rounds; full query watchdog60s
methods.conclusion: Actual native algorithm and author convex program retained, including EditRegionsCuda and restoring original-path coverage. Source audit reused and current call sites checked.
limitations: Installed native API does not expose every region statistical acceptance/cap reason; do not claim proved safe region merely from returned polytope.
Clarabel solver and Kinova task distribution are declared differences from published FR3 experiment.

methods.identity: Unchanged author SCSPlanning biconvex solver via EI_ZO minimum_time track
methods.formula: min sum_i T_i; alternate FixedPoints and FixedVelocities convex programs with Bezier position/derivative control constraints; Q_{k+1}-Q_k and second differences scaled by T and T^2
methods.objective: Optimize both trajectory geometry and segment durations within fixed regions; not merely retime a fixed path
methods.collision: Bezier convex-hull region membership; shared unit velocity/acceleration boxes and zero endpoint velocity; independent common trajectory validation
methods.stopping: Author relative duration improvement tol.01; external60s worker watchdog limits author loop and solves
methods.conclusion: Five official files match vendor and installed package byte-for-byte. Actual CPU corridor solve passed shared motion/region validator; controls and durations saved.
limitations: Author biconvex solver is local and conservative in its trajectory representation.
Author solver does not expose per-iteration termination metadata through this API; external timeout remains authoritative.

methods.identity: Local projected perspective GCS MISOCP reconstruction with explicit SCIP backend
methods.formula: Binary unit flow phi, homogeneous membership A z<=b phi, per-region delta=sum z_out-sum z_in, SOC ||delta||<=length; minimize sum length, degree<=1. Decode source-goal flow and check algebraic/region residuals.
methods.objective: Shortest PWL path in supplied local region graph, not whole free C-space
methods.collision: EI-ZO region graph plus common final collision validation and region repair; all final segments mapped to original pool IDs
methods.stopping: Model construction deducted from remaining60s; SCIP limits/time receives remainder, gap1e-6, numerical feasibility1e-9; no silent fallback
methods.conclusion: Real binary SOC optimization and independent primal/path algebra gates; dedicated CPU tests matched exhaustive simple-corridor oracle and preserved infeasible/no-incumbent cases.
limitations: Local reconstruction, not recovered author LGCS source.
Only optimal-status solution of supplied graph supports local-graph optimality; time-limit incumbent is not globally optimal.

cpu_regression.scope: CHOMP/STOMP, TrajOpt, OMPL and SCIP GCS dedicated tests; canonical Model.cuda disabled

ompl_budget_probe.note: The 18s fixture deadline avoids a 60s CPU-only stress run; actual 60s planning override is used and tested above the former 10s cap.
ompl_budget_probe.scope: Actual OMPL native RRTstar with impossible full-space barrier CPU fixture; no benchmark tasks and no GPU

prior_diagnostic_failure.reason: First standalone diagnostic omitted dtype=float when converting author object-valued controls. Production adapter already explicitly converts to float; diagnostic corrected to the same conversion.

scsto_probe.scope: Author LSCS/SCSTO CPU optimizer and common validator fixture; no physical robot performance claim.

findings.detail: Method stopping descriptions still state10s OMPL search; current explicit config planning_seconds is60 and runtime honors it. Keep historical10s comparisons distinct and update current method descriptions.

observed_descriptions.RRTCONNECT: At most 10 s search and 0.5 s vertex reduction, within 60 s total query; first solution behavior retained.
observed_descriptions.RRTSTAR: 10 s single native solve plus at most 0.5 s vertex reduction, 60 s total query. Main profile disables costly validated-progress observation.

findings.detail: README describes repaired_dev BoxBoxGradient error as unresolved; subsequent narrow fix and independent tests now exist. Historical outcome must remain preserved; do not retrospectively change it.

limitations: This verifies identities/formulations and tested interfaces, not every possible numerical failure.
No rankings were used to change solver settings; no new algorithm or framework was introduced.
CHOMP/TrajOpt adaptation labels are necessary technical identities, not explanations used to dismiss bad results.
